guitar.modelsText: ESP Explorer-style / ESP KH models / Gibson Explorer
guitar.evidence: James Hetfield's ESP Explorer-style "Iron Cross" guitars and Kirk Hammett's ESP KH signature models (and earlier Jackson/Gibson Flying V/Explorer use) are extensively documented.

tone.target: tight Marshall thrash rhythm with dry upper mids
tone.profile: tight Marshall thrash rhythm with dry upper mids
tone.summary: A classic Marshall-style chain using a Boost for attack, Distortion for core grit, an AC30 TB amp model, and the UK Vintage 4x12 cab to achieve a dry, high-mid focused thrash rhythm tone.

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and background noise inherent in high-gain rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for aggressive tones.

blocks.purpose: Increase signal level and sharpen the pick attack for tight gallops.
blocks.gap: None. Essential for punchy rhythm playing.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core aggressive grit and saturation needed for thrash metal.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is a general choice; specific JCM-style models are preferred but unavailable. This provides necessary high gain.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British high-mid punch of a Marshall/Plexi style amp.
blocks.gap: The AC30 TB is chosen for its characteristic mid-range focus, mimicking the desired JCM800 tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary high-end definition.
blocks.gap: None. Standard choice for this genre/tone.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the tone by boosting upper mids for punch and tightening the low end.
blocks.gap: None. Essential for achieving 'dry, punchy rhythm' with emphasis on mids.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder. Disabled to avoid unwanted wash or movement.
blocks.gap: The 'avoid' list explicitly bans chorus, so this module is included but deactivated.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder. Disabled to maintain dryness and aggression.
blocks.gap: The 'avoid' list explicitly bans delay wash, so this module is included but deactivated.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal natural room ambience without sounding washed out or muddy.
blocks.gap: Used sparingly to add dimension while respecting the 'dry' requirement.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture Marshall/Plexi cabinet character and enhance high-mid punch.

proposals.reason: Better captures the desired JCM/Plexi mid-range focus and punch.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased realism and definition in upper mids.
